title: 622. Maximum Vacation Days

examples.explanation: Stuck in city 0, collecting 1 per week.

hints: Roll a one-dimensional DP over weeks: dp[city] is the best total ending that week in that city.
Week 0 is reachable from city 0 via a flight or by staying; later weeks transition from any city with a flight in.
Unreachable states stay at negative infinity and the answer is the best value after the last week.
